description: Wire shapes of the usage API, the generation estimate and the usage data model. Rate card: rate-card-v1.json; allowances: allowances-v1.json. Authority: docs/architecture/ai-generation-platform.md section 10 and docs/product/ai-layer-2026-10.md section 5. Conventions (private/no-store, quoted decimal versions, RFC 9457 Problem Details) are those of contracts/decks and contracts/items.

conventions.credits: Integers. A fractional weight or cost is rounded up when it is turned into a debit; the ledger keeps costMicros for exact cost.
conventions.percent: Integer 0..100, rounded half up; percentUsed = (used + reserved) / total.
conventions.warn: A fair-use bucket sets warn=true above 80% of its monthly limit; the client then shows the quiet counter with its explanation.

endpoints.note: Read-only: it reserves and persists nothing.

usageResponseFields.period: Current allowance period; for FREE the calendar month of the bar.
usageResponseFields.entitlement: The snapshot the numbers came from. source is CONFIG until billing (#79) publishes snapshots to entitlement_inbox; validUntil is the snapshot expiry. A browser return URL never changes it.
usageResponseFields.credits.total: Bar size for the period. unlocked is how much of it may be spent now (all of it on paid plans; the weekly unlocked part on FREE).
usageResponseFields.dailyBurst: Paid plans only: at most dailyBurstMaxFraction of the bar per day. null on FREE.
usageResponseFields.weeklyUnlock: FREE only: quarter-bar unlock schedule. null on paid plans.
usageResponseFields.fairUse: Quiet counters outside the bar (speech-to-text, answer checks).
usageResponseFields.caps: Count caps per window; limit 0 means not offered on the plan.

estimateRequest.description: Exactly one of spec (a generation spec, see generation/http.json schemas.generationSpec) or edit.

estimateResponseFields.credits: p95 is the sum of rate card weights and is what a session start reserves; p50 is the typical cost when the prefix cache hits.
estimateResponseFields.percentOfPeriodAllowance: The composer shows 'about N% of the monthly limit' from p95.
estimateResponseFields.budget: Set when spec.settings.budgetPercent is given: {percent, capCredits}; capCredits = percent x remaining at estimate time, becomes the reservation and the planner input.
estimateResponseFields.canStart: false when p95 exceeds credits.remaining, or a count cap or daily burst would be exceeded. The button stays enabled; pressing it explains the options (409 USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED).
estimateResponseFields.warnings[].code: PERSONAL_DATA_SUSPECTED: a fragment of a source looks like personal data; ranges are UTF-16 offsets into the source text; the response never echoes the fragment, and the client offers to exclude it.

reservation.description: usage_reservation. Created with the session in one transaction (hold = estimate.credits.p95 or the budget cap); before a provider call the remaining hold sets max_tokens.

states.SETTLED: The session finished or was cancelled after at least one debit; the unspent remainder was returned.
states.RELEASED: The session was cancelled, deleted or failed without any debit; the whole hold was returned.
states.EXPIRED: An orphaned hold passed its TTL (learning.usage.reservation-ttl) and was returned.

transitions.guard: hold fits credits.remaining, caps and daily burst, else 409 USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED

transitions.trigger: session CLOSED or CANCELLED with at least one DEBIT
session CANCELLED, EXPIRED or deleted with no DEBIT

invariants: debitedCredits never exceeds heldCredits; a call whose cost would exceed the remaining hold is not made (artifact FAILED with BUDGET_EXHAUSTED).
A user never goes negative: credits.remaining >= 0.
A FAILED step caused by the provider is not debited; a repair inside a successful step is.

ledger.description: usage_ledger_entry: append-only; usage_balance is materialized in the same transaction. idempotencyKey is UNIQUE, so a retried write is a no-op.

GRANT.meaning: Allowance for a period or a weekly unlock; produced from an entitlement snapshot.

DEBIT.meaning: Consumption by a step result, in the transaction that stores the result.

REFUND.meaning: Return of a debit (for example a provider-side failure found later).

ADJUSTMENT.meaning: Operator correction with an audit reference.

EXPIRE.meaning: Unspent allowance removed at the end of its period or weekly unlock window; there is no rollover.

ledger.ledgerNotes: costMicros is the measured provider cost in millionths of a rouble; credits is what the rate card charged. The gap is the input for the 14-day weight review.

example.title: Usage limit reached
example.detail: The remaining AI budget does not cover this operation.

errors.note: STT and ASSESSMENT limits are fair-use: exceeding them returns the same code from their own endpoints (AI-15, AI-20); they are not debited from the bar.
